# Lindner Dental Associates, PC

> Comprehensive family and specialty dental care in Bedford, NH featuring pediatric dentistry, orthodontics, oral surgery, and cosmetic treatments.

Lindner Dental Associates, PC is a full-service dental practice in Bedford, New Hampshire offering specialized care across multiple disciplines. The practice is led by experienced dentists including Dr. Heidi Lindner Kurland and features specialists in pediatric dentistry, orthodontics (including Invisalign and LightForce braces), oral and maxillofacial surgery, and cosmetic dentistry with Botox services.

## Core Dental Services

- [Bedford NH Family Dentist & Orthodontics - Lindner Dental Associates, PC](https://www.lindnerdental.com): Homepage for Lindner Dental Associates offering comprehensive oral care in Bedford NH.
- [Pediatric Dentistry in Bedford, NH - Lindner Dental Associates, PC](https://www.lindnerdental.com/pediatric-dentistry): Pediatric dental services for kids and teens in Bedford, NH with specialized care for children.
- [Orthodontics, Invisalign & Braces | Bedford | Lindner Dental](https://www.lindnerdental.com/orthodontics): Orthodontic services featuring Invisalign, LightForce braces, and traditional braces.
- [Adult & Cosmetic Dentistry | Lindner Dental Associates](https://www.lindnerdental.com/adult-cosmetic-dentistry): Cosmetic dentistry services including veneers, whitening, and smile makeovers.
- [Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery in Bedford | Lindner Dental](https://www.lindnerdental.com/oral-and-maxillofacial-surgery): Oral and maxillofacial surgery services including implants, extractions, and TMJ treatment.
- [Cosmetic and Therapeutic Botox Services at Lindner Dental](https://www.lindnerdental.com/therapeutic-and-cosmetic-botox): Therapeutic and cosmetic Botox treatments for TMJ and facial aesthetics.
